generation_or_preprocessing_rule: Real MNIST training images (from 50,000 train split, seed=42) with label != 0, scaled by dividing uint8 pixel values by 255.0.
Real human writer digit labels from MNIST training split with digit 0 dropped.
Real MNIST validation images (from 10,000 validation split, seed=42) with label != 0, scaled to [0, 1]. Used for temperature scaling.
Real human writer digit labels for the 10,000 validation split with digit 0 dropped.
Untouched 10,000 MNIST test set filtered to digits 1..9 and scaled to [0, 1].
Real ground-truth labels for the untouched MNIST test set (digits 1..9).
Built by seeded randomized backtracking satisfying row, column, and 3x3 box all-different constraints.
Derived from solution_grid by removing cells in seeded random order while verifying unique solution (count_solutions == 1) until num_givens (25, 30, or 35) remain.

Blank cells receive uniform background noise U(0, 0.004) (detected by brightness < 0.025). Standard given cells receive held-out X_test images. Injected hard cells receive documented convex blends (1-alpha)*X_test(d_true) + alpha*X_test(d_confuser).
Produced by A* / UCS / Greedy search; cost = max(0, log P(read_digit|x) - log P(new_digit|x)).
